1. (Currently Amended) A method, comprising: applying a first coating material on a threaded region of an opening in a multi-piece assembly; inserting at least one fastener to the threaded region, the fastener including a mating thread selectively secured to the threaded region of the opening to create a first friction interface between the fastener and the multi-piece assembly; and tensioning the fastener between a load surface of the multi-piece assembly and a mating thread of the fastener to define a second friction interface between the multi-piece assembly and the fastener, the second friction interface being spaced away from the threaded region such that the first coating material does not influence the second friction interface, __wherein the first coating material is applied as a thread locking adhesive that cures to form a solid bond between the mating thread of the fastener and the threaded region__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising establishing the first coating material as being applied solely within the opening and in a substantially uniform thickness upon the threads, __wherein the thread locking adhesive is applied by inserting a plunger into the opening and dispensing the adhesive directly onto the threaded region__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising adjusting the first friction interface independent of the second friction interface __by controlling an amount of the thread locking adhesive applied to the threaded region__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3, wherein adjusting the first friction interface includes adjusting an amount of the first coating material applied to the threaded region, thereby increasing friction at the first friction interface without affecting friction at the second friction interface, __wherein the thread locking adhesive is dispensed in a controlled volume to achieve a predetermined torque resistance__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein applying the first coating material includes filling the opening at least partially with a coating fluid, __wherein the coating fluid comprises a liquid thread locking adhesive that flows into thread grooves and cures to form the solid bond__.

9. (Original) The method of claim 1, further comprising providing a second coating material at the second friction interface.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the second coating material includes a corrosion-resistant coating.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive __that chemically cures to form a permanent bond between the fastener threads and the opening threads__.

12. (Currently Amended) A method, comprising: applying a first coating material on a threaded region of an opening in a first multi-piece assembly included in plurality of multi-piece assemblies; inserting at least one fastener to the threaded region, the fastener including a mating thread selectively secured to the threaded region of the __opening__ to create a first friction interface between the fastener and the first multi-piece assembly, the fastener having a second coating material; tensioning the fastener between a load surface of the multi-piece assembly and a mating thread of the fastener to define a second friction interface between the multi-piece assembly and the fastener, the second friction interface being spaced away from the threaded region such that the first coating material does not influence the second friction interface; adjusting an amount of the first coating material applied to the threaded region in a subsequent multi-piece assembly, thereby increasing friction at the first friction interface of the subsequent multi-piece assembly compared with the first multi-piece assembly, the friction at the second friction interfaces of the first multi-piece assembly and the subsequent multi-piece assembly being substantially equal, __wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive that cures to form a solid bond__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, further comprising: establishing the multi-piece assemblies as connecting rods; wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive __that chemically cures to form a permanent bond__ and the second coating material includes a corrosion-resistant coating.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, further comprising establishing the first coating material as being applied solely within the opening and in a substantially uniform thickness upon the threads, __wherein the thread locking adhesive is applied by controlled dispensing to achieve uniform coverage__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, wherein applying the first coating material includes filling the opening at least partially with a coating fluid, __wherein the coating fluid comprises a liquid thread locking adhesive that flows into thread grooves and cures to form the solid bond__.
